_about: The public registry of this harness's per-machine secrets (DND-845). Names, paths and procedures only: NEVER a value. Schema and rules: ai/contracts/athena-machine-secrets.md -> The registry. Work-domain secrets are declared in the private overlay's overlay/secrets.json instead. An entry absent on a machine is listed by ai/bin/check-machine-secrets as 'not provisioned here', never failed.

secrets.name: claude-code-oauth
consumers: Claude Code
secrets.restart: none: Claude Code reads and refreshes it itself
secrets.rotate: claude /login (owner)

secrets.name: github-app-key
consumers: ai/bin/gh-athena (signs the App JWT per call)
secrets.restart: none: read on every gh-athena call
secrets.rotate: GitHub App settings -> Private keys: generate a new key, then delete the old one (owner)

secrets.name: github-app-install-token
consumers: ai/bin/gh-athena (cached installation token, GH_TOKEN in the gh child only)
secrets.restart: none: gh-athena re-mints it when it expires
secrets.rotate: rm the file; the next gh-athena call mints a new one from github-app-key

secrets.name: gitlab-bot-token
consumers: ai/bin/glab-athena for work-group projects (the token_file of the private overlay's gitlab .identities entry; GITLAB_TOKEN in the glab child only)
secrets.restart: none: read on every glab-athena call
secrets.rotate: GitLab bot user -> Access tokens: create a new token, then revoke the old one (owner)

secrets.name: gitlab-personal-bot-token
consumers: ai/bin/glab-athena for gitlab.com/cjpoll/ projects (the personal entry in ai/config/forge-identities.json; GITLAB_TOKEN in the glab child only)
secrets.restart: none: read on every glab-athena call
secrets.rotate: glab-athena refresh -R cjpoll/<project> self-rotates a live token (owner); a dead one: log in as the personal bot, create a PAT (scopes api, read_repository, write_repository; at most 365 days), write it with (umask 077; cat > ~/.claude/gitlab-personal-athena-token) (owner, per machine)

secrets.name: slack-bot-token
consumers: ai/skills/athena:slack/lib/slack.sh (curl --config in a temp dir)
ai/hooks/athena-slack-poll.sh
secrets.rotate: Slack app config -> OAuth & Permissions: rotate or reinstall (owner)

secrets.name: notion-personal-token
consumers: notion-personal MCP server via ai/bin/notion-athena-mcp (NOTION_ATHENA_TOKEN_FILE; NOTION_TOKEN in the MCP child only)
secrets.restart: reconnect the notion-personal MCP server (/mcp), or restart the session
secrets.rotate: Notion -> integration settings: refresh the secret (owner)

secrets.name: notion-work-token
consumers: notion-work MCP server via ai/bin/notion-athena-mcp (its default token file; NOTION_TOKEN in the MCP child only)
secrets.restart: reconnect the notion-work MCP server (/mcp), or restart the session
secrets.rotate: Notion -> integration settings: refresh the secret; the path is a symlink, so overwrite its target (owner)

secrets.name: inbox-machine-token
consumers: the athena inbox client (scripts/athena-inbox-client-run.sh)
the athena MCP headersHelper (DND-839)
secrets.restart: stop the inbox client (the */5 cron entry relaunches it), then reconnect the athena MCP server (/mcp)
secrets.rotate: reissue this machine's token on the athena server (per machine; never copy one between machines)

secrets.name: aws-cli
consumers: the AWS CLI
terraform, via eval of aws configure export-credentials inside one Bash call
secrets.rotate: aws login (owner)

secrets.name: aws-static-key
consumers: the AWS CLI via AWS_PROFILE
secrets.rotate: IAM: create a new access key, write it here, then delete the old key (owner); not a re-run of aws login

secrets.name: op-cli-config
consumers: the owner's 1Password CLI (no harness tool uses it)
secrets.rotate: op signin (owner)

secrets.name: gh-cli-hosts
consumers: the owner's gh CLI
secrets.rotate: gh auth login / gh auth refresh (owner)

secrets.name: glab-cli-config
consumers: the owner's glab CLI
secrets.rotate: glab auth login (owner)

secrets.name: gcloud-credentials
consumers: the owner's gcloud CLI
secrets.rotate: gcloud auth login / gcloud auth application-default login (owner)

secrets.name: GEN_SAAS_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
consumers: the gen_saas dev server: ai/bin/with-secret GEN_SAAS_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -- mix phx.server, or GEN_SAAS_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY_FILE once gen_saas dev config reads it
secrets.rotate: Anthropic console: create a new key, write it here, then revoke the old one (owner)

secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
consumers: gen_saas local dev email (config/runtime.exs outside prod): ai/bin/with-secret RESEND_API_KEY -- mix phx.server
secrets.rotate: resend.com dashboard, API Keys: create a new key, write it here, then revoke the old one (owner)

secrets.name: receipt-seal-key
consumers: ai/lib/receipt_seal.rb: ai/bin/critic-review seals and verifies critic verdicts; ai/bin/receipt-seal seals integration-gate's receipt and verifies it for locked-merge, gh-athena's merge and push guards, main-health and ready-and-idle (DND-1814). OPEN, both DND-1808's: (a) the sealer is an oracle to any same-uid process, so holding this key does not stop deliberate forgery; (b) gen_saas's gate cannot be sandboxed away from it
secrets.restart: none: read on every seal and verify
secrets.rotate: provision with ai/bin/receipt-seal init-key, once per machine from the main checkout (DND-1814; it prints only the path, mode and key id; init-key --check mints nothing). To rotate, rm the file, then run receipt-seal init-key (a sealing run would also mint one). Every receipt sealed under the old key then reads UNVERIFIED, so re-run the judge and the gate on any head still waiting to land

secrets.name: gitlab-runner-config
consumers: gitlab-runner run, as user gitlab-runner (OpenRC service gitlab-runner)
secrets.rotate: sudo -u gitlab-runner /usr/local/bin/gitlab-runner reset-token --config /home/gitlab-runner/.gitlab-runner/config.toml --name <runner name> (it mints the new glrt- token and writes it here); for a new runner, sudo scripts/setup-gitlab-runner --user gitlab-runner --runner <name>:-:3 (the untagged walt_ui runner: system-files/gitlab-runner-runbook.md) with the token on stdin (owner)

secrets.name: gitlab-runner-cjpoll-config
consumers: gitlab-runner run, as user gitlab-runner-cjpoll (OpenRC service gitlab-runner.cjpoll)
secrets.rotate: sudo -u gitlab-runner-cjpoll /usr/local/bin/gitlab-runner reset-token --config /home/gitlab-runner-cjpoll/.gitlab-runner/config.toml --name <runner name> (it mints the new glrt- token and writes it here); for a new runner, sudo scripts/setup-gitlab-runner --user gitlab-runner-cjpoll --runner <name>:<tag> with the token on stdin (owner)

secrets.name: gitlab-runner-cjpoll-deploy-config
consumers: gitlab-runner run, as user gitlab-runner-cjpoll-deploy (OpenRC service gitlab-runner.cjpoll-deploy); the deploy runner, never sharing a user with ci
secrets.rotate: sudo -u gitlab-runner-cjpoll-deploy /usr/local/bin/gitlab-runner reset-token --config /home/gitlab-runner-cjpoll-deploy/.gitlab-runner/config.toml --name <runner name> (it mints the new glrt- token and writes it here); for a new runner, sudo scripts/setup-gitlab-runner --user gitlab-runner-cjpoll-deploy --runner <name>:deploy with the token on stdin (owner)
